name: Verify Agentforce icon is visible on home page after login
objective: Validate that the Agentforce AI Assistant icon is displayed on the home page when a user logs in to the self-service portal.
precondition: User has valid portal credentials. Self-service portal is accessible.

steps.description: Navigate to the self-service portal login page
steps.expectedResult: Login page is displayed with username and password fields

steps.description: Enter valid credentials and click Log in
steps.expectedResult: User is authenticated and redirected to the home page

steps.description: Verify the home page has loaded completely
steps.expectedResult: Home page is fully loaded with all elements visible

steps.description: Verify the Agentforce icon is displayed on the home page
steps.expectedResult: The Agentforce icon is visible and clickable on the home page
